decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed part single/part two-storey rear extension and loft extension would, by reason of their position and design  represent an incongruous and obtrusive feature within the street scene harmful to the appearance of the area, contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.

Condition : 2 - The proposed loft flat would provide cramped and substandard living accommodation and the access to both flats would be insecure and unsatisfactory, leading to unacceptable living conditions for future occupiers, contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development), H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines), relevant Supplementary Planning Guidance and ENV- B.1.9 (Safety and Security).
description: Erection of a part single part two storey rear extension and roof extension forming 2 self contained flats
